info.title: Viewora Partner API
info.description:
Send your property and vehicle listings to Viewora. Your system owns the listing facts; Viewora owns tours, pages and moderation.

Money is always an integer: whole KES, or USD cents. Timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC. Unknown fields are refused.

Every response has an X-Request-Id header; quote it when you contact support.

WebhookEvent.description: POSTed to your endpoint. Check Viewora-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "t.body"> with your secret, and refuse anything older than 5 minutes. Delivery is at least once and not ordered: use id to drop repeats and data.listing.version to drop stale events.

post.description:

Scope: `listings:write`

patch.description:
Send only what changed. Sending media replaces the media list. If-Match: <version> is recommended. An update whose partner_updated_at is older than the stored one is ignored (applied: false, reason: stale). On a live listing, a price drop over 30%, a currency change or a 3rd change in 24 hours is held for review (202).

Scope: `listings:write`
